placement: Guardrail — tools/contract-gen/emit-typescript.ts changes only how the generated TypeScript codecs spend time, never what they accept: listOf and mapOf decode in one pass and stop at the first failure (the same first failure the three-pass version reported), and error paths are built lazily, only when a decode fails. Every accepted and rejected input, and every DecodeError path, expected and found, stays byte-identical; the shared vectors in test/contract.test.ts prove it. All generated TypeScript codecs are regenerated, never hand-edited.
